_meta.production_ready_note: HUMAN_APPROVED research/pilot decisions. NOT production deployment authorization. Requires explicit FIXEO product team production sign-off.
_meta.ai_claim_note: Current system = RULE_BASED_LOOKUP at LEVEL_0. 'FIXEO AI Price' and all equivalent labels PROHIBITED until LEVEL_4.
_meta.price_provenance_description: Human-calibrated FIXEO pilot price derived from Moroccan market research, standardized scope definition, safety review, and client/artisan dual-fairness analysis.

canonical_doctrines.dual_fairness_principle: A FIXEO price is acceptable only if it simultaneously protects the client from arbitrary overpricing AND the artisan from economically unsustainable underpricing. A FIXEO electricity price must additionally NEVER create an economic incentive for the artisan to bypass a safety condition to remain inside the fixed-price scope.
canonical_doctrines.electrical_safety_override: FIXEO_ELECTRICAL_SAFETY_OVERRIDE: When an unsafe or materially different condition is discovered — STOP → MAKE SAFE → EXPLAIN → DECLARE HORS PÉRIMÈTRE → DO NOT INCREASE SILENTLY → QUOTE → APPROVE → CONTINUE. Safety always overrides standardized pricing.
canonical_doctrines.hors_perimetre_workflow: 1.STOP 2.MAKE SAFE 3.EXPLAIN 4.DECLARE 'Cette intervention est HORS PÉRIMÈTRE PRIX FIXEO' 5.DO NOT INCREASE SILENTLY 6.QUOTE 7.APPROVE 8.CONTINUE. Client retains right to decline; 200 MAD diagnostic fee applies.
canonical_doctrines.diagnostic_absorption_rule: If the client accepts a qualifying standardized FIXEO electrical repair and that repair is completed during the SAME visit, the 200 MAD diagnostic fee is ABSORBED into the standardized intervention price. Client must NOT pay diagnostic + full intervention price for same-visit standard repair.
canonical_doctrines.materials_canonical: FIXEO standard electrical price = LABOUR + TRAVEL + DEFINED SMALL CONSUMABLES. Major electrical hardware (prise, interrupteur, luminaire, MCB/disjoncteur) = NOT silently included. Default: CLIENT_SUPPLIED. Alternative: ARTISAN_SUPPLIED_SEPARATELY_DISCLOSED — identify part, state spec/brand, state price, obtain client approval, then install.
canonical_doctrines.distributor_boundary: DISTRIBUTOR_CONTROLLED_EQUIPMENT is outside the standardized FIXEO electrician scope unless explicitly authorized. Examples: electricity meter, sealed utility equipment, distributor-controlled service breaker/disjoncteur de branchement, sealed upstream equipment. Private downstream equipment (distribution board, DIN-rail MCBs, circuits, outlets, switches, luminaires) may fall within artisan scope.
canonical_doctrines.distributor_boundary_note: FIXEO operates across Morocco. Distribution responsibility varies by city/territory/operator. Generic concept DISTRIBUTOR_CONTROLLED_EQUIPMENT is canonical — never encode a single operator as universal Morocco doctrine. Operator-specific details are research evidence only.
canonical_doctrines.earth_policy_principle: FIXEO must never represent an installation as compliant merely because the requested visible component was replaced. Earth/ground safety conditions must be evaluated before proceeding.
canonical_doctrines.multiple_item_policy: Approved pilot prices apply to ONE standardized item per intervention. MULTI_ITEM_BATCH_PRICING = NOT_YET_DEFINED. Batch work has different economics (shared travel/setup). Future dedicated batch-price research required. FIXEO must not imply single-item prices multiply linearly.
canonical_doctrines.no_urgency_modifiers: urgency_modifier = null. All time/urgency modifiers = null. Legacy FIXEO percentages are NON-CANONICAL. No surcharge approved in this phase.
canonical_doctrines.no_city_multipliers: city_adjustment = null. National pilot prices only. External city coefficients are research evidence only.

pilot_scope_contracts.conditional_fixed_note: The approved FIXEO price of 250 MAD applies ONLY when all standardized conditions are satisfied. The CONDITIONAL_FIXED architecture acknowledges that this service requires mandatory scope verification before the fixed price applies.
scope_standardized_conditions: ONE standard modular MCB requiring replacement
Accessible tableau — no distributor-sealed or utility-controlled components involved
Cause sufficiently identified — breaker itself confirmed defective (broken toggle, cracked housing, non-latching, internal failure)
Replacement MCB has technically appropriate specification (same voltage, current rating, type)
No burnt smell, scorch marks, or tableau overheating
No unexplained recurring tripping pattern requiring investigation
diagnostic_first_required_when: Breaker trips immediately on reset — downstream fault likely present
Breaker trips repeatedly without clear assignable cause
Burning smell or scorch marks visible inside tableau
Client cannot reliably identify which circuit the breaker controls
Any condition where the cause of failure is unresolved
pilot_scope_contracts.diagnostic_first_critical_note: An electrician must NEVER replace a breaker merely because it trips. If the reason for tripping is unresolved: DIAGNOSTIC_FIRST.

distributor_boundary.in_scope_confirmed: Private residential distribution board, standard DIN-rail MCBs, client-owned downstream circuits
distributor_boundary.out_of_scope: Distributor-controlled service breaker / disjoncteur de branchement, sealed upstream equipment, electricity meter, any utility-sealed component. These are outside FIXEO electrician scope.
distributor_boundary.identification_guidance: Distributor-controlled equipment: typically separately housed, operator-branded, has utility seal that must not be broken, adjacent to or preceding the meter. Private MCBs: DIN-rail mounted, in client's own tableau, no utility seal.
distributor_boundary.if_distributor_fault: 200 MAD diagnostic fee charged (artisan traveled and diagnosed). Client directed to appropriate distribution operator for that territory. FIXEO cannot resolve.

scope_included: Visual inspection of distribution board on arrival
Confirmation that MCB replacement is warranted (defective MCB verified)
Safe isolation — downstream circuits turned off, working area confirmed dead
Removal of defective MCB from DIN rail
Installation of client-supplied replacement MCB of correct specification
Functional test — circuit restored, MCB holds under normal load
Post-installation visible check of tableau for obvious anomalies
scope_excluded: Multiple MCBs (more than one replacement in scope)
DDR/RCD work — different device type, higher cost

materials_policy.client_label: Main-d'œuvre + déplacement — disjoncteur fourni par le client
materials_policy.client_guidance_on_part: Client must supply a replacement MCB of identical specification: same current rating (e.g. 16A, 20A, 32A), same pole count (1P or 2P), same type. Certified brands: Schneider, Legrand, ABB, Hager. Available from electrical wholesalers.
materials_policy.artisan_supply_protocol: If artisan supplies MCB: certified brand only, identify spec, state price, obtain client approval before installation. Never install uncertified or unspecified breaker.

diagnostic_policy.when_included: MCB physically defective confirmed on arrival without investigation — proceed directly to replacement.
diagnostic_policy.when_diagnostic_first: Cause uncertain, repeated tripping, or downstream fault suspected → book diagnostic service first (200 MAD).
diagnostic_policy.absorption: If diagnostic confirms single defective MCB and client accepts same-visit replacement: 200 MAD diagnostic fee absorbed into 250 MAD disjoncteur service.

mandatory_safety_checks: Turn off all downstream circuits before opening and working in panel
Verify working area is dead before touching any conductors
Do NOT work on live busbars
Verify replacement MCB specification matches original
Test after installation before closing tableau
complexity_escape_rules: Breaker trips immediately on reset → DIAGNOSTIC_FIRST → downstream fault investigation
Burning smell or scorch marks in tableau → SAFETY_OVERRIDE → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE
Busbar damaged, overheated, or corroded → SAFETY_OVERRIDE → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE → tableau assessment
Multiple MCBs defective → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE → full tableau assessment quote
DDR/RCD is the component requiring replacement → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE → DDR installation quote
Three-phase circuit → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE → specialist quote
Distributor-controlled equipment identified → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE → redirect to appropriate operator
Replacement MCB specification cannot be verified → pause → verify before proceeding
Wiring behind MCB burnt, oversized, or undersized → SAFETY_OVERRIDE → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE
Cause of tripping unresolved → DIAGNOSTIC_FIRST before any replacement
pilot_scope_contracts.client_disclosure: Prix FIXEO : 250 MAD — main-d'œuvre et déplacement. Le disjoncteur est fourni par le client (même calibre que l'original). Ce prix s'applique uniquement si le disjoncteur est physiquement défectueux. Si le disjoncteur saute de façon répétée, un diagnostic préalable (200 MAD) est nécessaire pour identifier la cause.
pilot_scope_contracts.artisan_disclosure: Prix FIXEO remplacement disjoncteur : 250 MAD — main-d'œuvre seule. Client fournit le disjoncteur (même calibre). Ne jamais intervenir sur le disjoncteur de branchement ou tout équipement scellé du distributeur. Si le disjoncteur saute immédiatement au réenclenchement : déclarer hors périmètre et proposer le service de diagnostic.
